notes.title: FULL GAME + EXPANSION
notes.content:
STEAM players will get not only the base version of the game but also the content of the expansion we're working on. So next to the already astonishing amount of content (200.000 words, 85 sex animations, almost 30 sequences of animated cumshots and over 1000 static images) you'll also get additional scenes from the super hot expansion - detailed list below:

[list]
[*] new sexy events with Bianca – crazy public sex scene with her fiancee named Diesel and then a photo session with Poly, who is not only a talented photographer but also a slutty pole dancer
[*] we’re going deeper into Serena’s past and she reveals one of the most shameful episodes in her life
[*] expanded story line with huge breasted Nicole, including some old school office romance and a secret rendezvous, during which she fulfills Carlos fantasies about a threesome with Nancy’s mother (PARTY WITH FRIENDS)
[*] revisiting the “Secret allure” and meeting Ivone (ELEANOR 3), where inspiring scene with Serena, Jade and a lot of erotic toys takes place
[*] whole new plot line with the original game character – Melissa. A lot of naughty scenes including dress up and role playing
[*] arousing new story including Julian and Bianca doing something forbidden behind Diesel’s eyes
[/list]
